Sixteen point five BEHIND. 761.3 to 744.8. Behind the team he plays Sunday, on the road, against a 5-2 club that just went 118.7. FOUR AND FOUR BY SUNDAY NIGHT. And when it happens I want Reggie to read that bench number aloud on this desk — SIXTY-ONE AND A HALF — and then I want the commissioner to BOLT IT TO THE DOOR.

turns.speaker: reggie-banks
turns.text: Mel, you've asked for a hearing, a notary, a plaque and a commissioner with a bolt gun — that's a hardware store, not a case. Here's mine, and it's short: Trevor Ashby is 4-3 with 744.8 points for, fourth in this conference, more than Halyard Bay's 733.5, Foundry District's 720.7 and Milltown's 705.2. One flat Sunday at 103.8. Week 8 at Quarry Road he wins and he's 5-3. He's 4-4 Sunday night, I say it loud on this desk, no melting required. Scoreboard.

turns.speaker: curtis-vaughn
turns.text: Fourth in points for, biggest bench of the week, and a first prediction on the books for both of them. We'll know Sunday night whether it's 5-3 or 4-4. That's the show.
